# THE ROOM LAYOUTS (written by layouts.js from data.js; do not edit by hand)

How each room really stands. `#` = a plot (42 m), `.` = no plot. North is up. Under a grid: every plot, as id, name (district). The id `Pcc-rr` is its COLUMN and ROW in this grid
(P00-00 = top left), which is where it stands in the game, not where the zone plan sheet drew it. `world` = the room's place on the One World map, in plots.
